D: In 1957 Indy races Soviet agents to find a crystal skull in the jungles of Peru.
P: Serve the drinks when Mutt and Indy meet at the diner.
S: the diner near campus where Mutt tracks Indy down

Thick fries cooked twice, at 140C then 190C until crisp, salted and served in paper cones with tomato sauce. Cut 1kg potatoes into thick fries. Fry at 140C for 6 minutes, rest, then at 190C until crisp. Salt with flaky salt and serve in paper cones with tomato sauce.
Snapper cubes cured in lime juice with red onion, chilli and coriander, served in small cups with sweet potato and corn.

Flaky pastry filled with cumin-spiced beef, onion, olive and egg, crimped and baked golden, with a punchy green chilli and coriander salsa. Fry an onion with 400g beef mince, 2 tsp cumin and 1 tsp paprika until browned. Stir in 50g chopped green olives and a chopped boiled egg and cool. Cut 4 sheets of shortcrust into 12 rounds, fill, fold and crimp. Brush with egg and bake at 200C for 20 minutes. Blitz a bunch of coriander, a green chilli, a garlic clove, lime juice and olive oil for the salsa.
M: Chicken pieces marinated in garlic, cumin, paprika and lime, roasted at 220C until charred, with a green sauce of coriander, jalapeño and mayo, and fries.
the jungle chase in the Amazon

Rump strips seared in a smoking wok with red onion, tomato, soy and vinegar, tossed with crisp chips and served with rice the Peruvian way. Cook 1kg frozen chips at 220C until crisp. Cook 300g rice. Slice 700g rump steak into strips and toss with soy, garlic and cumin. Sear in a smoking wok in batches for 1 minute. Add a red onion in wedges and 2 tomatoes in wedges and toss 1 minute. Add 3 tbsp soy and 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, return the beef, toss with the chips and coriander. Serve with rice.
W: taking the skull home to Akator

Clear lemon jelly set with gelatine in glasses, layered with sliced grapes and berries so it sparkles, kept cold in a lead-lined fridge. Soak 6 gelatine sheets. Heat 500ml water with 150g sugar and the juice of 3 lemons and stir in the gelatine. Layer halved green grapes and blueberries in glasses, pour over the jelly and set 4 hours.
K: Mutt rolling up on his motorbike in a leather jacket

Vanilla ice cream blended with milk and malt powder until thick, poured into tall glasses. For each shake, blend 3 scoops vanilla ice cream with 150ml cold milk and 1 tbsp malted milk powder until thick. Pour into tall glasses. Makes four.

Dice 400g very fresh snapper and cover with the juice of 6 limes for 15 minutes. Add thin red onion, a chopped chilli and coriander. Serve in small cups with cubes of boiled sweet potato and corn kernels.

m.how: Marinate 1.2kg chicken drumsticks in 3 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika and lime juice. Roast at 220C for 40 minutes until charred. Blitz coriander, a jalapeño, 100g mayo and lime for sauce. Serve with 1kg fries.
